messages:
anya (infra): Noticed a small-host p50 uptick for very short chat requests after the new kernel-ranking change. Impact mostly single-token flows, ~+2ms p50. Happened at 02:07 UTC.

kevin (runtime): I can repro locally. Top of the CPU flame points at host_tokenize and kernel_picker_slowpath. Putting trace: https://go/perf/trace/3333333333

jena (perf): sampling dump from canary: 
```
34% host_tokenizer::tokenize
16% host_http2::coalesce_wait
12% runtime::kernel_picker::evaluate
6% kvcache::get (high variance, misses up)
```

omar (backend): After the selector tweak we started including `runtime_hint` in the cache key to avoid cross-batch kernel mismatch. That hint is generated per-request (entropy based) for better packing. Might be the cause.

kevin (runtime): ugh. If hint is ephemeral we definitely fragment the kv cache. I thought it was stable per-connection but it's not.

anya (infra): Two orthogonal issues: 1) key fragmentation -> kv miss spike; 2) http2 coalescer now defers flush up to 700us while waiting for token window which hurts tiny tails. Both line up with the perf numbers.

jena (perf): Quick A/B: revert `runtime_hint` out of kv key for seqlen<=6 -> miss-rate drops ~2.1x, p50 returns near baseline. Patch locally: https://git/redwood/runtime/compare/mini-kvkey-fix

sam (sre): Repro script (non-blocking, parallelized):
```bash
seq 1 1000 | xargs -n1 -P16 -I{} curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"ok"}' $INGRESS | jq -r .latency
```
shows consistent regression pre-fix.

omar (backend): For coalescer we can add heuristics: if predicted_length <= 6 OR header X-Short-Stream: true then bypass coalesce and flush immediately after frame. I'll prototype header flag in ingress.

kevin (runtime): Plan: revert kvkey composition for small seqlens (kevin), and add deterministic enum fallback for runtime_hint if we need to keep it. Also coordinate with omar on short-stream header for coalescer bypass.

anya (infra): Tests we need: microbench for 1/2-token flows, unit that asserts identical logical request -> identical kv key, and smoke for http2 tiny-stream latency. jena please add to perf-regress.

jena (perf): Will add harness and baseline traces. Posting before/after flamegraphs in this thread after canary.

perf-bot: canary roll started at 3333333400.

sam (sre): I'll set a temp alert: tiny-chat.p50 > 12ms -> page. 10m window to reduce noise.

kevin (runtime): Opening PR #4809 to trim key composition + #4810 to add deterministic enum + tests. Linking here after CI.

omar (backend): I'll open an ingress PR for X-Short-Stream header and coalescer bypass. We can default to false to avoid affecting long flows.

anya (infra): Good. If canary looks clean we'll merge and propagate. Keep this thread updated with numbers and traces (jena/kevin).

jena (perf): After rollback I already see p50 back to baseline in local canary run. Will post flamegraphs in ~20m.

kevin (runtime): thx. Long-term: we should document which runtime metadata are included in kv keys and add lints to prevent accidental ephemeral fields being added.

anya (infra): Agree. Adding that as follow-up action. Incident INC-2031 created, owners kevin/jena/omar.
